toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":5,"perceivedCorrectness":60,"actionability":6,"reason":"The brief makes a credible case that the switch to Tallyline (with no-harm and found-on-floor falls making up most of the rise) and the other changes muddy the picture, and it gives clear next steps; but it doesn't pick one cause, it pushes back against a director who won't wait, and it leaves the night-share rise and the 3m40s call-bell times without a full explanation."}

output.reason: The brief makes a credible case that the switch to Tallyline (with no-harm and found-on-floor falls making up most of the rise) and the other changes muddy the picture, and it gives clear next steps; but it doesn't pick one cause, it pushes back against a director who won't wait, and it leaves the night-share rise and the 3m40s call-bell times without a full explanation.
